versionImpact.rationale: This pre-stable maintainer-authorized refinement makes prerelease immutability explicit in KFD-1, makes KFD-4 the declared-perspective principle with timeline and replay engineering profiles, separates KFD-5 perspective genesis from qualification, advances the KFD-5 interface to version 2, and advances draft KFD-6 to version 3 with required replay-grounded perspective experiments. The fixed outer package line remains v1.0; major is the honest decision and machine-interface impact.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Before the first stable release, maintainer-authorized KFD-1/4/5/6 refinement changes decision meaning in place while preserving every prior prerelease artifact. KFD-1 makes that boundary explicit; KFD-4 becomes the declared-perspective principle; KFD-5 separates perspective genesis from qualification; KFD-6 requires perspective experiments. Consumers must bind prerelease citations to package version or commit.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

KFD-4 additively publishes the perspectiveReplay version 1 interface. KFD-5 primitiveDiscovery advances from schemaVersion 1 to 2 and requires perspectiveGenesis with explicit genesis method and replay basis. Draft KFD-6 advances from schemaVersion 2 to 3, requires replay-grounded perspectiveExperiments, and makes boundaryHypothesis conditional.

The package additively publishes schemas/kfd-4/perspective-replay.schema.json through the existing schema wildcard and strengthens expected release artifacts without removing or renaming a package path or export.

KFD now uses Buildchain v2 floating workflow refs with a consumer-owned buildchain.contract-lock.json, so Buildchain runtime contract drift is checked before heavy build or promotion work while retaining floating-ref upgrade flow.
site/kfd-site.json preserves existing fields while adding the /foundation route, foundationPage projection, futurePicture structure, and explicit first-screen/detail separation.

KFD-4/5/6 usage bodies explain observer-bound timelines, perspective-preserving and contrastive replay, perspective genesis, qualification, and autonomous replay experiments while stable /N/usage routes remain unchanged.
KFD refreshes pre-build and artifact-side KFD-3 witnesses to include the new participant-consumable perspective replay schema and updated foundation explanation.
KFD-3 collaboration interfaces now declare explicit valueEvidence that binds participant-facing value claims to fact artifacts, evidence artifacts, KFD-2 trust assessments, and residual-risk state.
KFD now ships an explicit machine-bound public KFD-2 release trust claim and passes it into Buildchain release passport generation.

KFD-2 generic trust claims identify both KFD-4 timeline and replay profiles, KFD-5 version 2 replay-aware perspective genesis, and KFD-6 version 3 replay-grounded experiments while continuing to downgrade KFD-6 because no adopter has proved the draft autonomous capability.

Decision documents now use stable numbered paths under decisions/KFD-N.md, while usage documentation uses docs/KFD-N-usage.md to distinguish authoritative decision text from consumer implementation notes.
KFD now declares its package version through an anchored/manual release manifest so package version state is an explicit release fact rather than an auto-derived Buildchain side effect.

The KFD to site-libkungfu-dev propagation graph now targets the downstream site's actual main branch and documents the exact KFD package surfaces consumed by kfd.libkungfu.dev, without changing the release propagation graph contract.
KFD-1 now defines breaking, additive, none, and unclassifiable as the generic compatibility-impact core, with release versioning as one projection rather than the only interpretation.
standards.json additively registers the KFD-4 perspective replay schema as an integration-time surface, and the KFD-1 witness binds its source and artifact digest from that fact source.

KFD-4 additively publishes a version 1 contract for perspective-preserving and contrastive replay, including source-view boundaries, reconstruction loss, degraded state, and primitive-signal mismatches.

KFD-1 now publishes a machine-readable schema for canonical reader URLs, latest aliases, immutable version artifact URLs, artifact digests, source coordinates, lineage, site consumption, and archive policies that prevent same-version digest drift or destructive deletion of immutable publication prefixes.
